verdict.rationale: Docusaurus documents global custom CSS files through the classic theme, swizzling to replace theme components with your own, and extending layout with React components. MDX also lets you import your own or npm components into pages. Community users independently praise its configurability, flexibility and out-of-the-box theme. Missing for 10: explicit evidence on font customization and theme color/variable tokens, and documented injection of custom client-side JS scripts.
